text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
ganization of Nuling and Parang into municipalities under
Executive Order No. 82, series of 1947;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, Fresident of the
Philippines, upon the recommendation of the Secretary of
the Interior, and pursuant to the provisions of section 68
of the Revised Administrative Code, the boundary line
between the municipalities of Parang and Nuling, both of
the Province of Cotabato, is hereby defined and fixed as
From a point, at the center of the mouth of the Simuay River,
approximately one kilometer north of the sitio of Simuay, in the
municipality of Nuling, on the seashore, following the course of
this river upstream and meandering in a general casterly direction
to the source thereof somewhere north of and adjacent to the sitio
of Pinging, municipality of Nuling, on the boundary between the
former municipal district of Balut, now a part of the municipality
of Nuling and the former municipal district of Buldun, now a part
of the municipality of Parang; thence southeasterly in a straight
line, following the same Balut-Buldun boundary until its intersection
with the Manuangan River somewhere south of the sitio of Migkato,
municipality of Parang. (Reference used in this description: Bureau
of Public Works Road Map of Cotabato Province, Scale 1:250.000.)
This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done. in the City of Manila, this 28th day of May, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
1975
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
